latin: Ideo uoces et uerba in magico opere efficaciam habent, quia illud in quo primum magicam exercet natura, uox est dei.

mentions.context: essary to acknowledge that characters and ﬁgures are more powerful in a magical work than any ma- terial quality. Just as characters are proper to a magical work, so numbers are proper to a work of Kab- balah, with a medium existing between the two, appropriable by declination between the extremes through the use of letters; ibid., 23–25). “Ideo uoces et uerba in Magico opere efﬁcaciam habent, quia illud in quo primum Magicam exercet natura, uox est Dei. Quaelibet uox uirtutem habet in Magia, in quantum Dei uoce formatur. Non signiﬁcatiuae uoces plus possent in Magia, quam signiﬁcatiuae, et rationem conclusionis intelligere potest, qui est profundus ex praecedenti conclusione. Nulla nomina

quam possit, quaecunque qualitas materialis.
